title: sprint-6-docs
description: Sprint 6: Documentation & Quality of Life. 3 items: update CHANGELOG+bump version 0.41.0, clean up stale rtk/RTK refs, custom model config.

title: Add code coverage to CI
description: No cargo llvm-cov or cargo tarpaulin in CI. Cannot identify untested code paths in filter fallback logic. Fix: Add coverage job after tests, upload as CI artifact. File: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Effort: medium.

title: sprint-2-critical-tests
description: Sprint 2: Critical Test Coverage. 4 items: fix CLAUDE.md broken ref, tests for hooks/verify_cmd.rs, tests for analytics/gain.rs, tests for telemetry + discover/learn.

title: Fixtures cloud-system
description: Create test fixtures for: cloud (aws, docker, kubectl, psql, sqlite, curl, wget) and system (ls, tree, grep, find, env, read, json, log, wc, diff, format, summary, deps). Store in tests/fixtures/cloud/ and tests/fixtures/system/. Effort: medium.

title: MCP Server
description: HEADROOM: MCP tools (headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve, headroom_stats). RTCO: none. Fix: Create new binary target using rmcp crate with tools: rtco_compress (content-type-aware), rtco_analyze (token savings), rtco_retrieve (cached/compressed content). Effort: medium.

title: Update CHANGELOG bump version
description: Version still 0.40.0 despite major changes: headroom ports (89f20da, ceabad0), workspace refactor, SIGPIPE fix, JVM support, CI/CD cleanup, TOML filter engine. Fix: Add entries for all post-0.40.0 changes, bump to 0.41.0. File: CHANGELOG.md, Cargo.toml. Effort: small.

title: Tests for telemetry + discover/learn
description: Modules lacking tests: telemetry_cmd.rs (consent parsing, ping URL validation), discover/rules.rs, discover/mod.rs, learn/mod.rs, parser/types.rs. Fix: Add cfg(test) modules with standard test patterns. Effort: small.

title: OpenClaw execSync removal
description: SECURITY: openclaw/index.ts uses execSync (lines 12,19,29) from node:child_process — blocks event loop, injection risk. Upstream RTK v0.42.1 removed all execSync. Fix: Replace with execFileSync (no shell) or async spawn/execFile. File: openclaw/index.ts. Effort: small.

title: ContentRouter content-type routing
description: HEADROOM: ContentRouter detects content type (JSON, Code, Logs, Text) and dispatches to specialized compressor. RTCO has basic content_detector.rs but no routing dispatch. Fix: Augment content_detector.rs with ContentType enum, create Router struct mapping ContentType to best compressor. Effort: medium.

title: Fixtures JS-TS modules
description: Create test fixtures for: pnpm, npm, vitest, jest, tsc, next, prettier, playwright, prisma, lint. Store in tests/fixtures/js/. Real command output required. Effort: medium.

title: Fix dependabot target branch
description: CI/CD: .github/dependabot.yml specifies target-branch: 'develop' which does not exist — only main. Dependabot updates silently failing. Fix: Change target-branch to main in both cargo and github-actions sections. File: .github/dependabot.yml. Effort: small.

title: Tests for hooks/verify_cmd.rs
description: Security-sensitive module (SHA-256 hook integrity checks, TOML filter validation) has zero #[cfg(test)] code. Fix: Add tests for verify_hook_integrity() with known-good and known-tampered fixtures, test_toml_filter() with valid/invalid TOML. File: src/hooks/verify_cmd.rs. Effort: small.

title: Missing ecosystem filters
description: HEADROOM/UPSTREAM: Missing filters for 9 ecosystems: Terraform/OpenTofu, Deno/Bun, Swift/SPM, PHP/Composer, Elixir/Mix, Haskell/Stack, LLVM/Clang, Ansible/Puppet, Bazel/Buck. Priority order: Terraform -> Deno/Bun -> Swift -> PHP -> Elixir -> Haskell -> LLVM -> Ansible -> Bazel. Each is new filter module following src/cmds/ pattern. Effort: large.

title: Pin CI actions to SHA commits
description: SECURITY: .github/workflows/ci.yml uses actions/checkout@v4, dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable, Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 — all mutable tags. Fix: Pin each to specific commit SHA, comment with human-readable tag. Effort: small.

title: Snapshot tests Python-Ruby-cloud-system
description: Add assert_snapshot!() tests for Python (ruff, pytest, mypy, pip), Ruby (rspec, rubocop, rake), cloud (aws, docker, kubectl, psql, sqlite, curl, wget), system (ls, tree, grep, find, env, read, json, log, wc, diff, format, summary, deps). Effort: medium.

title: CodeAwareCompressor tree-sitter
description: HEADROOM: AST-aware code compression preserving syntactic validity via tree-sitter. RTCO uses line-based regex only. Fix: Add tree-sitter crate, create parser grammars for Rust/TS/Python/Go, implement AST traversal for safe truncation + block condensing + comment stripping. Effort: large.

title: Full HTTP Proxy Server
description: HEADROOM: Production HTTP proxy intercepting LLM API requests (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) with semantic caching, rate limiting, cost tracking, health endpoints. RTCO's proxy is simple CLI passthrough. Fix: Add HTTP server (axum/actix behind feature flag), provider protocol handlers, semantic caching, rate limiting, health endpoints. Effort: large.

title: install.sh path traversal rejection
description: SECURITY: Install script at install.sh does not reject archive entries containing ../ or symlink targets outside extraction root. Upstream RTK v0.41.0 added this check. Fix: Add check after listing archive contents — reject any path starting with /, containing .., or symlink target outside extraction root. File: install.sh. Effort: small.

title: sprint-1-security
description: Sprint 1: Security & Infrastructure Fixes. 5 items: install.sh path traversal, OpenClaw execSync removal, is_operational_command whitelist fix, add insta crate dep, fix dependabot branch. Blocks all subsequent sprints.

title: TOIN Tool Intelligence Network
description: HEADROOM: Privacy-aware distributed learning — ToolSignatures, semantic patterns, compression optimization. RTCO has only stub refs (hashing.rs, toin_confidence_threshold). Fix: Implement learning loop, ToolSignature storage, federated learning support, pattern export. Effort: large.

title: Clean up stale rtk RTK references
description: ARCHITECTURE.md contains ~20 references to rtk/RTK instead of rtco. RTK_META_COMMANDS const naming misleading. Fix: Update ARCHITECTURE.md refs, rename RTK_META_COMMANDS to RTCO_META_COMMANDS. Effort: medium.

title: Fixtures Python-Ruby
description: Create test fixtures for: ruff, pytest, mypy, pip (Python), rspec, rubocop, rake (Ruby). Store in tests/fixtures/python/ and tests/fixtures/ruby/. Real command output required. Effort: medium.

title: Fixtures git-gh-cargo
description: Create test fixtures from real command output for: git (log, status, diff, show, branch, stash, worktree), gh, cargo. Store in tests/fixtures/<ecosystem>/ subdirectory. Use include_str! with workspace-root-relative paths. Effort: medium.

title: headroom wrap equivalent
description: HEADROOM: wrap command intercepts CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, Copilot) through proxy. RTCO has rtco init for hooks but no wrapping. Fix: Create rtco wrap <agent> that detects agent binary, creates wrapper script, verifies with rtco verify. Effort: medium.

title: Tests for analytics/gain.rs
description: rtco gain is the flagship user-facing feature but module has zero tests. Fix: Add tests for print_daily_stats(), print_summary_stats(), print_history(), calculate_economics(). Snapshot test for full gain output format using synthetic history DB. File: src/analytics/gain.rs. Effort: medium.

title: Add integration tests to CI
description: CI workflow does not run cargo test -- --ignored (integration tests requiring real rtco binary). Fix: Add step with nightly or weekly trigger. File: .github/workflows/ci.yml. Effort: medium.

title: sprint-3-fixtures
description: Sprint 3: Test Fixtures for All Modules. 4 groups: git/gh/cargo, JS/TS (pnpm/vitest/jest/tsc/next/prettier/playwright/prisma/lint/npm), Python+Ruby, cloud+system. Depends on Sprint 1-2.

title: Fix CLAUDE.md broken reference
description: CLAUDEMD links to src/cmds/README.md which does not exist (pre-workspace layout). Navigation blocker for new contributors. Fix: Create file or update link to CONTRIBUTING.md. File: CLAUDE.md. Effort: small.

title: Snapshot tests JS-TS modules
description: Add assert_snapshot!() tests for JS/TS module filters: pnpm, npm, vitest, jest, tsc, next, prettier, playwright, prisma, lint. Uses fixtures from Sprint 3. Effort: medium.

title: sprint-5-ci-cd
description: Sprint 5: CI/CD Pipeline Automation. 4 items: pin CI actions to SHA, add integration tests to CI, add CD release/deployment, add code coverage (cargo llvm-cov).

title: is_operational_command whitelist fix
description: SECURITY: main.rs lines 2531-2577 whitelist missing ~10 command variants: Format, Mypy, Pipeline, Jest, Sqlite, Wc, Gradlew, Mvn, Aws, Psql, HookAudit, Rewrite, Pipe, Run, Proxy, Trust, Untrust, Hook. Whitelist fails open (no check=bypass). Fix: Audit Commands enum exhaustively, add catch-all _ => false. File: src/main.rs@2531-2577. Effort: medium.

title: sprint-4-snapshot-tests
description: Sprint 4: Snapshot & Token Savings Tests. assert_snapshot! + savings >=60% for every module. 4 groups matching Sprint 3 fixture groups + token savings verification for 11+ modules.

title: sprint-7-headroom
description: Sprint 7+: Headroom Feature Ports. 8 items: ContentRouter, HTTP Proxy Server, CodeAwareCompressor, TOIN, MCP Server, headroom wrap, Prometheus/OTel, ecosystem filters. Deferred.

title: Snapshot tests git-gh-cargo
description: Add assert_snapshot!() tests for git (log, status, diff, show, branch, stash, worktree), gh, and cargo filter output. Uses fixtures from Sprint 3. File: src/cmds/git/git.rs, src/cmds/git/gh_cmd.rs, etc. Effort: medium.

title: Add CD release deployment
description: CD workflow is identical to CI — no release binaries, no GitHub Releases, no crates.io publish, no deb/rpm packages despite cargo-deb/cargo-generate-rpm being configured. Fix: Add cargo build --release, GitHub Release creation, optional cargo publish and deb/rpm. File: .github/workflows/ci.yml or new .github/workflows/release.yml. Effort: medium.

title: Add insta crate dependency
description: TESTING INFRA: insta crate (with filters feature) not in any Cargo.toml — zero snapshot tests possible despite CLI_TESTING.md mandate. Fix: Add insta (with filters feature) to rtco-cli dev-dependencies. Unblocks all snapshot test work. File: crates/rtco-cli/Cargo.toml. Effort: small.

title: Prometheus OTel Langfuse
description: HEADROOM: /metrics for Prometheus, OTLP exporters, Langfuse traces. RTCO: SQLite tracking only. Fix: Add optional prometheus feature flag to rtco-core, expose /metrics endpoint, add OTLP tracing behind telemetry-otel feature. Effort: medium.

title: Custom model configuration
description: Add ~/.config/rtco/models.toml config file with model name, context limit, cost per token. Wire into analytics/cc_economics.rs for per-model cost tracking. Inspired by Headroom's HEADROOM_MODEL_LIMITS. Effort: small.

title: Token savings verification
description: Add count_tokens assertion (savings >= 60%) for 11+ modules: ruff, pytest, mypy, pip, env, find, format, json, log, ls/read/tree, wc, psql, sqlite, wget, docker, kubectl. Extract count_tokens helper into tests/common/mod.rs for reuse. Effort: medium.
